Read and send mail from any provider — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail or your own server.
Reads your inbox and sends mail as you, using the account you enter. Credentials stay encrypted on this phone.
Tip: Gmail, Yahoo and iCloud need an app-specific password, not your normal login password.
Browse, download and upload files on your own Nextcloud server via WebDAV.
Lists, downloads and uploads files on the Nextcloud server you enter, as your user.
Create an app password in Nextcloud → Settings → Security → Devices & sessions.
Your media libraries, recently added movies/shows, and what\'s playing now.
Reads your Jellyfin libraries, recently added items and playback state. Never touches your media files.
API key: Jellyfin dashboard → API Keys → New API Key.
See sensor states and toggle your lights, switches and scenes.
Reads the state of your smart-home entities and can switch lights, switches and scenes on/off.
Long-lived access token: Home Assistant → your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.
Steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts — read only, stays on this phone.
Reads steps, heart rate, sleep sessions and workouts from Android Health Connect. On-device only: unibot never uploads this data anywhere.
Why does unibot want health data?

unibot can answer questions like “how many steps did I take this week?” or “how did I sleep last night?”. It reads:

• Steps and distance
• Heart rate
• Sleep sessions
• Workouts

The data never leaves your phone — it is only read when you ask. You can revoke access any time in Android Settings → Health Connect.
Health Connect needs Android 14 or newer. This phone runs an older version.
Your Matrix rooms and DMs — read recent messages, send messages.
Reads your joined rooms and recent messages, and can send messages as you.
Your profile, owned games and recently played games.
Reads your public Steam profile, owned games and recent playtime. Read-only.
API key: steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Your SteamID64: steamid.io or your profile URL.
Search podcasts and follow shows — episode lists stay on your phone.
Searches the public iTunes podcast directory and downloads episode lists from show feeds. No account, nothing uploaded.
